title: GHOST Collective
image: 'public/ghost-collective.png'
---

The [GHOST Collective](https://ghostcollective.github.io/) is a group of Open Science enthusiasts in the Netherlands that create serious games to make Open Science even more fun. Since 2020, the GHOST Collective have created various games and have been present at events, conferences and festivals. You can find out more about their games [on their website](https://ghostcollective.github.io/games.html).

In addition, the GHOST Collective have collected Data Horror Stories that tell of unfortunate situations that occurred due to a combination of bad luck and a lack of planning for catastrophes. You can find the Data Horror Stories in the sidebar on the left. These Data Horror Stories were collected for Data Horror Week - the last week of October - between 2020 and 2022.
